description: Shared test vector for natsumi push encryption v1 (ADR 0029). TEST ONLY: both private keys below are disposable, were made for this file from public labels, and must never be used for anything else.
encoding: Every binary value is standard base64 (RFC 4648 section 4) with padding. Keys are P-256: private keys raw 32 bytes, public keys X9.63 uncompressed 65 bytes.
layout: ct is the AES-256-GCM ciphertext followed by its 16-byte tag (no nonce inside). AAD is the UTF-8 bytes of messageId. salt is epk followed by the device public key. In CryptoKit: AES.GCM.SealedBox(combined: nonce + ct).
